[[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] '''Blaster Repair Kit''' was a repair kit designed to have all the small tools needed to maintain, repair or customize [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]] and [[Blaster rifle/Legends|rifles]]. The kit contained a [[pulse adaptor module tester]], a [[collimator beam focuser]], a [[prismatic crystal aligner]], [[static pulse adaptor]] modules, an [[Heter-Valve|energy converter valve]], [[multiple gas valve nozzle]]s, a spare [[gas container]], a spare [[trigger cable]] and a [[variable pressure adjustor]]. It also had room for three spare [[Power cell/Legends|power packs]].
